Attaching the encryption matrix (encryption-matrix.pdf) and a KMS keyflow diagram (kms-keyflow-diagram.png). Summary: 

- At-rest: AES-256-GCM applied to all persisted model artifacts and customer blobs.
- KMS: Keys managed in AWS KMS (customer-dedicated CMKs for Dedicated/Private customers; service keys for Hosted tenants).
- Key separation: Tenant keys never exported; role-based access controls enforced via IAM and HSM-backed CMKs for private deployments.

I also added short SIG references in the doc mapping pages to CC6 (system & communication protection) and CC8 (data privacy) where applicable.
